title: When People Doubt You: A Story of an Intervention
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: This is a story, not a lesson. Read it and think about what people thought of a plan of yours.

I said: look, it is my whole life story, not to talk about myself. When I first started buying land in a little fishing village in the middle of nowhere, my parents called my sister, and they had an intervention.

They said: we need to tell Jose to go to a psychologist, because he is leaving his city job, his city company. He is folding it up and going to a small fishing village that is fifty years away from anything happening.
There were dirt roads, I said, and nobody there, and one hotel with ten rooms. That is all there was.
And I was like: no, it is going to happen.
So it is a lonely world as an entrepreneur, I said, when you believe in something.
What do the people closest to you say about your plan?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write one plan of yours that people doubted.
Write what you believed, and what you did.

check.q: Who called my sister, in my story?
What did they want me to do?
What did I say to myself about it?

recap: When people doubt you, check your evidence and keep going.
